A [[Yuuzhan Vong]] '''shaper''' was bribed by [[Nom Anor]] after the Yuuzhan Vong [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|captured]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Because of this, the shaper grew a concealed coralcraft for Anor in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], which was being changed to [[Well of the World Brain|house]] the [[World Brain]].
